operations.title: Nima verifies the corrected saturated Rees attachment is full rank
operations.body: Event 1258 completes the corrected saturated Rees test. For projectively coalescing forms q and T-q, the logarithmic normal coefficient is -1/q; edge blocks give -1/y_i. The 45-dimensional kernel decomposes into five rank-1 edge blocks and ten rank-4 boundary-pair blocks, all full rank away from the declared marked divisors. Each rank-4 block has all four existing Walsh characters, so the map mixes declared columns but creates no new character or generic homology. This refines the unsaturated 2X_A Koszul test.
